## Biofilm

::: columns
::: {.column width="40%"}
-  Bacteria encased in extracellular matrix
    -  1000x antibiotic resistance c.f. free-floating bacteria
    
-  Systemic administration limited by toxicity  
:::

::: {.column width="5%"}
:::

::: {.column width="55%"}
:::{r-stack}
![](files/images/sa_biofilm.jpg){width="400"}
:::
:::

:::

## Cerament

::: columns
::: {.column width="55%"}
- 60% calcium sulfate
    - Antibiotic carrier
- 40% hydroxyapatite
    - Osteoconductive
:::

::: {.column width="10%"}
:::

::: {.column width="35%"}
:::{r-stack}
![](files/images/cerament_composition.png){width="400"}
:::
:::
:::

## Cerament

:::{r-stack}
![](files/images/cerament_bacterial_profile.png){height="500" fig-align="center"}
:::

::: {.footer}
- _Cerament G_ = G+ and G-, except MRSA (and resistant organisms); Saline
- _Cerament V_ = G+ only; Iohexol
:::

## Elution

:::{r-stack}
![](files/images/cerament_mic.png){height="500" fig-align="center"}
:::

::: {.footer}
- _Minimal Inhibitory Concentration (MIC)_ = Lowest concentration of an antibiotic to prevent visible growth in vitro
- _Minimal Biofilm Eradication Concentration (MBEC)_ = Lowest concentration of antibiotic to completely eradicate biofilm
- _PMMA_ = Most elution within 24 hours
:::
